candidates.question: Is the PDRE-001A architecture application-qualified across the relevant electrical, mechanical, thermal, insulation, partial-discharge, reliability, EMC, and safety requirements?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether migration readiness can be evaluated beyond R3.
candidates.why_insufficient: Demonstrations and work underway do not establish application qualification.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: An approved qualification result with scope, requirements, result, event time, knowledge time, and provenance.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could change the readiness boundary; no commercial migration conclusion follows automatically.

candidates.question: Does approved evidence establish actual production or field deployment of PDRE-001A?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether R5 FIELD_DEPLOYED can be evaluated.
candidates.why_insufficient: The records explicitly prohibit or bound a current field-deployment inference.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: A dated, approved production-deployment or field-operation record with independently traceable provenance.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could change the current field-deployment boundary.

candidates.question: Are the copper, rack-space, and efficiency claims independently supported?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether current technical and economic source claims can become stronger evidence.
candidates.why_insufficient: All three dimensions remain source claims not independently verified.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: One independent technical source or approved test artifact for each claim selected for verification.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could strengthen or contradict constraint and economic interpretations without itself establishing migration.

candidates.question: What supplier, manufacturing, and qualified-capacity evidence exists for PDRE-001A?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether supply availability and manufacturing readiness can be represented beyond UNKNOWN.
candidates.why_insufficient: Product demonstrations and forward timing do not establish qualified production capacity or supplier readiness.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: Approved supplier/manufacturing evidence that distinguishes announced capacity from qualified available capacity.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could resolve current supply and manufacturing unknowns.

candidates.question: Does repository-external verification support a PDRE-001B centralized 800VDC / SST dependency-transfer chain?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether PDRE-001B can move from active subhypothesis to an assessed candidate.
candidates.why_insufficient: The approved packet does not authorize a readiness assignment or complete dependency-transfer reconstruction for PDRE-001B.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: A bounded approved packet that directly addresses the facility-level old path, alternative path, transferred dependencies, and readiness evidence.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could determine whether PDRE-001B is assessable; outcome may remain unresolved.

candidates.question: Can source independence and derivative lineage be established for the seven indexed evidence items?
candidates.decision_affected: Whether repeated source claims represent independent confirmation.
candidates.why_insufficient: Repository metadata identifies issuers but not full source lineage or derivation relationships.
candidates.minimum_new_evidence_needed: Source-lineage metadata connecting each claim to its original or derivative source.
candidates.expected_information_value: Could change independence counts but not directly assign technical readiness.

limitations: These are candidates for human review only.
No candidate was executed or automatically prioritized.
